subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Zakir is a fearless and **__impetuous__** fighter, a former Guantanamo prisoner who earned a reputation for brutality on the battlefield.
solution:
The correct answer is: **cautious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impetuous"** means acting quickly and without thought or care; impulsive. (आवेगपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** His impetuous decisions often get him into trouble.
 
 
 
• **"Cautious"** refers to being careful to avoid potential problems or dangers; not impulsive. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example:** She was very cautious while crossing the busy street.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'impetuous'** is **'cautious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **cautious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eager** (उत्सुक): Having a keen or enthusiastic desire or interest.

 
 
• **Example:** She was eager to start her new job.
 
 
 
• **Fierce** (उग्र): Having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness.
 
 
• **Example:** The fierce lion roared loudly in the jungle.
 
 
 
• **Restive** (अवज्ञाकारी): Unable to remain still, silent, or submissive, especially because of boredom or dissatisfaction.
 
 
• **Example:** The restive crowd grew impatient during the long wait.
 
 

37:T993,
The correct answer is **Option 3**
